test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

RAIR, UBLS, XCOT, ADRU, ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d22b0931b937efb7da5c8247555b1c79cf61d2c6c0c12f02cc520b2c9d0a7c2e.png] 

**Given:**

RAIR, UBLS, XCOT. ADRU,?

**Logic:** Addition of (3) to the positional values of the first and third alphabet and addition of (1) to the positional values of the second and fourth alphabet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0daa5a3e49fc538565e8330a1bbbd13973840429005c683d37f8df2bcd7b3631.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "DEUV".**
